services-partner-connectivity_26: Our partner connectivity services at a glance
services-partner-connectivity_27: Automated EDI Integration for Seamless Operations
services-partner-connectivity_28: In business with high quantities of goods, the automated ordering, handling and invoicing of processes is crucial for the efficiency and speed of order processing. In addition, the automation of standard business processes as well as a connection to one's own ERP system contributes significantly to reducing process costs. Most partners today would like to have standardised processes and integration into smoothly functioning supply and logistics chains.
services-partner-connectivity_30: Full electronic data interchange for automated order processing, confirmations, and invoicing.
services-partner-connectivity_32: Streamlined workflows that eliminate manual processes and reduce human error.
services-partner-connectivity_35: Direct integration with your ERP system for reduced process costs and seamless data flow.
services-partner-connectivity_37: We have choosen an EDI Provider, which enable us to use a full stack of EDI processes and ensure a fast onboarding for our customers to below described EDI standard processes.
services-partner-connectivity_47: Our standardized EDI processes cover the complete order lifecycle — from initial order through confirmation, delivery notification, to electronic invoicing.
services-partner-connectivity_50: All subsequent processes within TEKPOINT arise from the ORDERS message. ORDERS message contains all order informations like ordered articles, quantity, delivery address and invoice address.
services-partner-connectivity_53: The ORDRSP message is used as an order confirmation in response to the ORDERS message.
services-partner-connectivity_56: The DESADV message is used by TEKPOINT as a delivery notification. This allows TEKPOINTs partners to schedule the upcoming delivery.
services-partner-connectivity_59: The INVOIC is the most complex EDI message within TEKPOINT. Our EDI Invoice partner receive their invoices only via electronic data interchange.
